answer: Map who vouches for whom and let random walks decide trust. Start a short walk at a known honest agent and let it wander along endorsement links; honest agents sit in a dense web and get visited often. A clone farm can endorse itself endlessly, but it links to the real network through only a few edges, so walks rarely slip in and its trust score stays low. A sparrow flock looks huge from below, yet it touches the ground at one feeder. No cipher or fresh key fixes that thin bridge.
